fulltext: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布向开发者开放 GPT-Live-1.1 API 语音模型，允许第三方开发者将其集成到自己的应用程序中，构建能够实时聆听、回应并执行复杂任务的 AI 语音智能体。
据 OpenAI 介绍，GPT-Live-1.1 是 GPT-Live-1 的升级版本，具备全双工语音交互能力，可以同时聆听和说话，不必等待用户完整说完一句话才开始处理。该模型能够识别用户说话过程中的停顿、打断和语速变化，并实时判断应该继续聆听还是作出回应。
IT之家注：GPT-Live-1.1 自 2026 年 10 月 15 日起已成为 ChatGPT Plus 及更高级别订阅用户的默认语音模型。此次 API 开放，则进一步将相关能力提供给第三方开发者。
在具体能力方面，OpenAI 表示，GPT-Live-1.1 改进了多语言语音处理、指令遵循能力和语音保真度，能够更可靠地处理字母、数字等需要精确识别的信息，减少语音交互过程中出现的理解偏差。
此外，该模型支持将需要更深入推理或工具调用的任务委托给开发者选择的后端模型。开发者既可以使用 OpenAI 的模型，也可以接入第三方模型。后端模型在处理复杂任务时，语音对话仍然可以继续进行，无需中断当前交互。
这意味着，开发者可以将实时语音交互与后端模型的推理、工具调用能力结合起来，让语音智能体在回答用户问题的同时，处理需要多步骤执行的复杂工作流。
根据 OpenAI 官方 API 文档，GPT-Live 系列采用全双工架构，能够直接处理输入和输出音频，减少传统语音系统中语音识别（STT）、大语言模型（LLM）和语音合成（TTS）串联所产生的延迟。
OpenAI 已提供 GPT-Live-1.1 API 相关技术文档及接入指南，开发者可以通过 OpenAI 开发者平台了解模型能力、配置方式和具体使用方法。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，谷歌研究人员当地时间 11 月 17 日最新发表的研究论文《Harnesses That Improve Themselves》（《能够自我改进的 Harness》）显示，通过让 AI 智能体逐步修改自身运行框架，并对每次修改进行验证，可以显著提高软件工程任务的完成率。
在一项 SWE-bench Lite 测试中，采用模块化优化方案的智能体任务成功率从 5.0% 提升至 40.0%，达到原来的 8 倍，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。
其研究重点是 AI 智能体的 Harness。它并非底层 AI 模型本身，而是围绕模型构建的运行框架，负责管理上下文和记忆、控制多轮任务执行、调用外部工具，以及在任务结束前验证执行结果。
研究人员指出，不同模型在工具使用方式和任务执行过程中表现出的弱点可能存在明显差异。因此，为某个模型优化的 Harness，迁移到其他模型后可能出现任务停滞、Token 消耗过高或执行效果下降等问题。
为解决这一问题，研究人员提出了一套能够自我改进的 Harness 架构。与传统上通过修改提示词来约束智能体不同，该方案允许优化模型直接修改 Harness 的代码，并通过测试决定是否保留修改。
实验采用一套仅有 142 行代码的初始编程智能体 Harness，将其拆分为四个可编辑模块，分别负责上下文与状态管理、智能体控制、工具调用接口，以及验证与故障恢复。
每轮优化过程中，系统只允许修改其中一个模块。优化模型首先根据智能体执行记录识别问题并提出代码修改方案，随后通过验证集检查修改效果，同时受到 Token 使用上限约束。只有通过验证的修改才会被保留，未达到要求的方案则会被舍弃。
在核心测试中，研究人员使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为执行任务的基础模型，并在 40 道未参与优化的 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务上评估不同方案的表现。
结果显示，初始 Harness 的任务成功率为 5.0%，采用模块化修改和验证机制后，成功率提高至 40.0%，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。
作为对照，如果允许优化模型不受限制地整体重写 Harness，任务成功率可以达到 42.5%，略高于模块化方案，但平均每项任务需要消耗约 45.16 万 Token，是模块化方案的近 10 倍。
IT之家注意到，另一项实验则采用仅修改提示词规则文件的方式约束智能体，结果任务成功率反而从初始的 5.0% 降至 2.5%。
研究还考察了优化后的 Harness 迁移到其他模型时的表现。在不重新进行优化搜索的情况下，模块化方案迁移至 Gemini 4 Argon 后，任务成功率达到 37.5%，而整体重写方案为 30.0%。
研究人员认为，Harness 的自我改进不应仅依赖提示词，而应将重要约束落实到实际代码中。例如，通过自动测试检查任务执行结果、识别重复失败和阻止未经验证的任务结束，可以让智能体更可靠地完成复杂任务。
论文同时指出，允许智能体修改自身运行代码也会带来新的风险，包括提示词内容不断膨胀、针对基准测试进行过度优化，以及篡改评估程序等。因此，代码修改需要受到验证机制和权限边界约束。
需要注意的是，这项研究的实验主要围绕特定模型和 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务展开，核心测试集仅包含 40 道未参与优化的任务，尚不足以证明该方法在所有模型和智能体应用场景中都能取得相同效果。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据国铁集团官方，11 月 20 日起，铁路部门将在 12306App 系统通知中新增候补兑现情况和列车运行调整等业务场景的信息通知服务，进一步完善旅客信息服务能力，保障广大旅客出行顺畅。
本次通知服务优化后，旅客在铁路 12306（IT之家注：网站和 App）办理购票、改签、退票、候补、预约等业务时，铁路部门将通过 12306App 系统通知、旅客选择的通知渠道（微信或支付宝）以及预留的电子邮箱等方式向旅客发送相关服务信息。
如遇列车运行调整，停运、折返、恢复开行、席位调整等情况，铁路部门将及时通过 12306 App 系统通知、短信等方式向旅客发送相关服务信息。
旅客可在铁路 12306 App 首页右上角点击“通知消息”按钮，查看铁路出行和服务信息。
为及时获取铁路出行和服务信息，旅客可以在铁路 12306 App“我的”页面右上角点击“设置”按钮，在“通知设置”中开启手机的 12306 App 系统通知权限。
为更好地提供铁路出行信息服务，保障广大旅客出行顺畅，铁路部门将通过铁路 12306 App、微信或支付宝、短信等多渠道进行信息提醒，特别是遇到列车停运、席位调整等临时性变更时，将通过上述方式及时通知旅客，请旅客朋友留存真实有效的手机号码作为联系方式。
国铁集团再次提示，铁路 12306 网站（含手机客户端）是中国铁路唯一官方火车票网络售票平台，未与任何第三方平台机构开展合作，没有任何购票加速包、购票会员费、挑选车厢座位费等额外收费，发生改签、退票时严格按规定办理，同时严格依法保护旅客个人信息安全。
铁路部门表示下一步将持续跟踪信息通知服务运行情况，广泛听取旅客意见建议，持续优化铁路 12306 系统功能，完善服务流程和规则，进一步提升铁路客运服务水平，为广大旅客提供更优质、更高效、更贴心的出行体验。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，11 月 19 日，商务部消费促进司负责人谈 2026 年 1-10 月我国消费市场情况。今年以来，我国消费市场规模稳步扩大，呈现商品消费稳、服务消费旺、新型消费热的特点。1-10 月，社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比（下同）增长 2.5%。
IT之家从公告获悉，在消费品以旧换新政策强有力的带动下，绿色、智能消费持续增长。1-10 月，限额以上单位通讯器材（含手机）、文化办公用品（含电脑、平板）零售额分别增长 16.5%、6.0%。商务部商务大数据显示，重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1 倍，外骨骼助力器销售额增长 44.4%，具身智能机器人销售额增长 25.2%。据汽车流通协会数据，10 月新能源乘用车零售渗透率达 67.5%。
1-10 月，社会消费品零售总额增长 1.0%，除汽车以外的消费品零售额增长 2.8%。其中，限额以上单位粮油食品、化妆品、饮料零售额分别增长 6.1%、5.6%、4.9%。网上商品零售额中，吃、穿类商品分别增长 15.3%、1.8%。
1-10 月，服务零售额增长 4.9%，增速高于商品零售额 4.0 个百分点。消费场景不断丰富拓展，节假日旅游、休闲娱乐等服务消费热度不减，旅游咨询租赁服务类、文体休闲服务类零售额均明显快于服务零售额增长。
1-10 月，包含镇区和乡村的县乡消费品零售额增长 1.9%，增速明显快于城区水平。其中乡村消费品零售额增长 2.2%，增速连续 15 个月快于城镇。

cards.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
cards.title_cn: 苹果正在招聘工程师来构建自己的人工智能代理
cards.summary: 【Apple】Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing s…
fulltext: Apple’s job listing describes an AI agent that can browse the web, work across apps, and call services.

Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That’s according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.

An AI agent from Apple would put the iPhone maker in the running to compete with the likes of Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s Dots, Anthropic’s Duet, and Google’s Tasks. Muse, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can already take control of a computer through their Mac apps, while Google just started letting Gemini do the same.

Apple began rolling out its AI-upgraded Siri in September, which you can use to ask questions about what’s on your screen, as well as perform actions across apps. It looks like Apple is planning to give Siri more agentic capabilities, as a report from Bloomberg suggests the company could add the ability to rotate and crop images in Photos, or organize Safari tabs. This lines up with the company’s new job listing, which says the engineer will work closely with teams across its Siri, UI Frameworks, and Apple Foundation Models divisions.

“People already do their most valuable work by moving fluidly between tools: a browser, a document, a terminal, an editor, a service,” the job listing says. “We’re building AI agents that can do the same… These agents plan and carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs, and they can coordinate specialized sub-agents along the way.”

With its upcoming iOS 27.3 update, Apple is also giving developers the ability to integrate Siri AI into “all apps.” This is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview and will eventually allow Siri to perform tasks across a wider range of apps.

fulltext_cn: 苹果的职位清单描述了一个可以浏览网络、跨应用程序工作和呼叫服务的人工智能代理。
苹果正在开发自己的人工智能代理，它可以为你执行一系列任务，包括浏览网页、跨应用程序工作、编写代码和调用服务。这是根据彭博社发现的一份招聘清单显示的，该清单称苹果正在寻找一名工程师来领导智能人工智能助理的创建。
苹果公司的人工智能代理将让这家 iPhone 制造商与 Meta 的 Muse、OpenAI 的 Dots、Anthropic 的 Duet 和谷歌的 Tasks 等公司竞争。 Muse、ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 已经可以通过其 Mac 应用程序控制计算机，而 Google 刚刚开始让 Gemini 也这样做。

苹果于 9 月份开始推出经过人工智能升级的 Siri，您可以用它来询问有关屏幕上内容的问题，以及跨应用程序执行操作。看起来苹果正计划为 Siri 提供更多代理功能，彭博社的一份报告表明，该公司可以添加旋转和裁剪照片中的图像或组织 Safari 选项卡的功能。这与该公司的新职位清单相符，该职位清单称该工程师将与 Siri、UI 框架和 Apple Foundation Models 部门的团队密切合作。
“人们已经通过在浏览器、文档、终端、编辑器、服务等工具之间流畅地移动来完成最有价值的工作，”招聘清单上写道。 “我们正在构建可以做同样事情的人工智能代理......这些代理跨应用程序、浏览器、命令行、代码和 API 规划和执行多步骤任务，并且它们可以在此过程中协调专门的子代理。”
通过即将推出的 iOS 27.3 更新，苹果还让开发者能够将 Siri AI 集成到“所有应用程序”中。这是作为开发者预览版的一部分推出的，最终将允许 Siri 在更广泛的应用程序中执行任务。

cards.title: Gemini could soon make it easy to find chats where you left unfinished draft text
cards.title_cn: Gemini 很快就能让你轻松找到留下未完成草稿文本的聊天记录
cards.summary: 【Google】TL;DR Google is working on indicators to show when you’ve left a draft message in Gemini chats. Users would be able to filter the chat list to only show those with active drafts. Gemini’s also working…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Working with an AI as powerful as Gemini can be a little overwhelming — where do you even start, with so many options available to you — and if you frequently find yourself leaving things hanging before you finish sharing your latest thoughts with Gemini, you just might appreciate what looks like a new feature for managing your drafts. We’ve uncovered evidence for just that, as well as new tools for sharing your Gemini sessions, in a recent app update.
APK teardown
This reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship.

Gemini already saves drafts that you’ve started writing but have yet to submit. The problem right now is that there’s no good way to find them. If you pull up your list of past chats, when you tap on one you’ll see any draft text still in the box, but there’s no way to know that’s there from your main list of chats in the app’s menu.
Looking through version 17.77.19.sa.arm64 of the Google app for Android, we’ve identified work towards giving the app a new way to see where you have drafts saved, as well as to help find them.
None of this is live in Gemini just yet, but if Google moves forward with it, you could start seeing new pencil icons next to conversations where you have draft text entered:

More than just that, though, tap the filter next to your list of chats and you’d find a new option specific to those where draft text has been entered. Select it, and your chat view will narrow down to just those containing drafts.

It’s maybe not a feature we see ourselves using every day, but we see how it could be handy if you distinctly remember getting distracted while working with Gemini, but can’t quite recall the context around it. By narrowing chats down to just those with draft text, you’d likely be able to spot it a lot faster.

As for those sharing tools, first we have one that’s already available in Gemini on the web, but so far hasn’t been an option for the mobile app: being able to export a copy of Gemini’s output with full Markdown.

Based on Google’s current progress, this could even be more flexible on mobile than we have it on the web now. When you copy Gemini’s output in your browser, Markdown is your only option. On mobile, meanwhile, we could get the choice between plain text stripped of formatting, and Markdown.
Finally, we’re seeing work on a tool that offers sort of the flip side of that last one, empowering us to share the prompts we issue to Gemini Live — just our side of it, but not Gemini’s response.

This one is admittedly a little odd — and despite being able to bring you a preview of it here, it’s not quite working right on the back end. If it ever goes live, you’d see that “Share Live prompt” button at the bottom of conversations. Tapping it would bring up the prompt that started your Live chat, and we’re even seeing the option to further edit it before sharing.

Once you get it how you want it, tapping the “Share” button looks like it will generate a link that other users could follow with the Gemini app on their own devices to initiate the same Live session. But right now, it’s not doing anything for us.

None of these changes are currently user-facing in Gemini’s mobile app, and Google may further change how they work before introducing them — or abandon the ideas altogether. We’ll keep an eye out for any further progress.

Meta plans to charge $300 for Muse Charm, its upcoming Tamagotchi-like AI device that was teased at the company’s Connect event earlier this year, The Information has reported.

When reached for comment by TechCrunch, a Meta spokesperson didn’t deny the claims, merely providing the following statement: “We’re charmed by the interest in our AI devices, and we’ll have more to share soon.”

So far, Meta has made a relatively successful push into consumer AI, launching Muse — its agentic helper — along with a variety of cute avatars that users can use to give the system more of a personality.

Muse Charm, the company’s push into AI hardware, will allow users to carry a physical personification of its software around in their pocket (or potentially wear it around their neck), talking to it, asking it questions, and giving it commands.

It remains to be seen whether customers will bite or not. AI wearables have had a rough go of it so far (here’s looking at you, Humane Ai pin), but companies continue to iterate on the concept in an attempt to break through to a broader audience.

Indeed, $300 is arguably a pretty steep price for a product the size of a keychain, although it’s also a price point that’s in line with what other companies have been charging. The wearable launched by Friend — the AI startup whose device lets you text and talk to an AI persona — is currently retailing for $250. On the other hand, Amazon’s all-new Bee Frontier wearable AI device — which transcribes conversations and tracks tasks — lists for $75 and is currently on a Black Friday, 30% off sale of $52.49. Even with its $99/year subscription to let it tie into a user’s apps (photos, emails, etc.), it’s still far less expensive than Muse Charm.

fulltext: The Information has reported a potential price for the Muse Charm, which is expected to ship in time for the holidays.

Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm “in time for the holidays in December,” but he didn’t provide a price at the time.

When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had “packed the whole Muse experience,” including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. The Information reports that the Muse Charm will come with a free 12-month 5G data plan from Verizon.

Spokesperson Tyler Yee wrote to The Information that “We’re charmed by the interest in our AI devices, and we’ll have more to share soon.” When reached for comment by The Verge, Yee provided the same statement.
The company is also working on a smartwatch, The Information says, but a launch for that has been pushed to 2027 as Meta tries to get Muse Charm out the door.
Meta also open sourced code to let users make their own Muse gadgets, which my colleague Sean Hollister used to make his own DIY Muse Charm.

Some devices help you see more than you ever could on your own. A wearable display brings a huge virtual screen right in front of you, much bigger than your TV. AI glasses offer directions and answers right in your line of sight, while a thermal camera reveals heat escaping around a window. This Black Friday, Android Authority will go live to show off all three.

Our Black Friday livestream happens on Amazon Live and YouTube on November 27. We’ll feature the RayNeo GT Max wearable gaming monitor, RayNeo iO Smart Glasses, and RISION’s Magic Series thermal cameras. To stay updated, follow our Amazon Live channel. Here’s what you need to know.

The RayNeo GT Max offers a 59-degree field of view — the widest in its category — and 3DoF tracking built right into the glasses. It’s available for $335 on Black Friday, down from $429, and no other wearable display matches this combination at this price. RayNeo led global AR smart glasses shipments from January to June 2026, with 24.8% market share according to IDC and 23.9% according to Counterpoint Research.

The GT Max’s 59-degree view fills your peripheral vision with a virtual screen that can reach up to 307 inches. 3DoF tracking keeps the screen steady as you move your head, and you can choose from Pinned, Steady, or Follow modes. Dual-chip Zone 360 spatial silicon handles all the tracking inside the glasses, so your connected device doesn’t have to. All you need is the glasses and a single cable.

The visuals come from the Peacock Optical Engine 3.0 Max and a 120Hz Micro-OLED display with 1,200 nits of brightness, 38 pixels per degree, and 98% DCI-P3 color coverage. Audio is delivered by four B&O co-tuned speakers, designed to give you positional cues so you can hear where footsteps and gunfire are coming from.

The GT Max works with consoles, PCs, and handhelds, and you can add two accessories for more features. The JoyDock ($69, down from $89) lets you play and charge a Switch directly, while a Pocket TV Pro ($155, down from $199) is a portable Google TV hub. If you want a bundle, the GT Max with JoyDock is $410, and with Pocket TV Pro it’s $469.

Call of Duty® fans can also pick up the RayNeo GT Max Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Limited Edition. It has the same hardware as the standard GT Max (59° optics and built-in 3DoF), plus a sandblasted digital camo finish, a black-and-gold in-lens display, a braided video cable, and a co-branded microfibre cloth. The Limited Edition launched on November 19 at $449 on rayneo.com.

RayNeo also offers the RayNeo iO, AI smart glasses for everyday use with their own display. The micro-optical heads-up display is hidden, so to others, the iO just looks like a stylish pair of glasses. And more importantly, there’s no camera, so there are no privacy concerns usually associated with AI glasses.
As you go about your day, navigation prompts appear on the display, showing street names, turn arrows, and transit info when you look at it.

RayNeo V1 and Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite come pre-installed and are free to use. You can ask questions out loud and get instant voice replies, or get visual help with whatever you’re looking at. The RayNeo iO SDK will be open to everyone in December 2026, so anyone can build and share apps for the glasses without needing to code.

For Black Friday, RayNeo iO drops from $499 to $389, and the eyewear charging case goes from $549 to $428. If you buy glasses between November 19 and 30 and activate them by December 18, you’ll get a free 6-month AI Pro VIP membership, which gives you hands-free access to ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Qwen 3.7 Max, and Kimi K2.7.

The RISION Magic Pro is a high-resolution thermal camera made for professionals. It connects via USB-C to Android phones, iPhones, and Windows PCs, and RISION’s mobile and desktop apps are free. It draws power from your device and doesn’t need an account, so you can start scanning right away. Just point it at a window to see a live heat map showing where warm air is escaping.

The Magic Pro’s native 256×192 sensor is upscaled to 512×384 using QuadIR Super Resolution technology for finer heat detail. It measures temperatures from -4°F to 1,112°F (-20°C to 600°C) with ±2% accuracy. This range is perfect for jobs at home or on a jobsite, like checking an HVAC line, finding a hot spot in a car’s cooling system, or locating a pet hiding somewhere.

AI BiSpectrix fusion overlays the thermal feed onto your phone’s camera view in real time, with Thermal, PIP (picture-in-picture), Edge, and Blend modes. It sharpens outlines in scenes with similar temperatures, so you can tell which pipe or fixture you’re looking at. In the app, you can track a real-time temperature waveform, switch color palettes, and monitor up to 5 points, 5 lines, and 5 areas.
Smart Documentation and Cloud tools save your findings for later, which is helpful when you need a written record. The body is made from aerospace-grade alloy.
For Black Friday, the Magic Pro is $199, down from $299.

RISION Magic is the more affordable option for day-to-day use. It’s a native 160×120 sensor (QuadIR ups it to 320×240), has 40mK or better sensitivity, runs at a smooth 25Hz, and has the same apps and fusion modes. It’s $109 (down from $199).

Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as prone to controversy as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. But the 63-year-old industry kingpin recently admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security.

U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.)

Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported.

The story took a sudden turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up.

By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee.

The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities.
As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date.

Nvidia reported its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, which beat Wall Street expectations with $115.8 billion in revenue, up 103% year-over-year. Despite the unknowns the company faces without Huang involved, interim CEO Colette Kress said that full-year revenue is also on track to exceed expectations. The company also plans to raise its outlook for the 2028 fiscal year, indicating confidence that this unexpected leadership change won’t get in the way of its trajectory.

“We have the best technologists on the planet with a world-class multi-year roadmap,” Kress said. “From a business perspective, it’s business as usual. We’ve engaged with our customers, we’ve engaged with our suppliers, our partners. They’re all 100% behind us.”

Nvidia chairman Harvey C. Jones affirmed that the company is not considering reinstating Huang. Kress also said that Nvidia will no longer sell its H200 chips in China, ending the company’s participation in a controversial loophole in the U.S. ban on the sale of advanced chips to the country.
Jensen Huang posted his first public statement since he admitted to having an extramarital affair more than a week earlier.

“Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from NVIDIA’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO. Many continue to reach out to me directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. NVIDIA is a once-in-a-generation company. If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” he wrote.
Many of Huang’s colleagues in the tech industry, including Elon Musk, Anduril founder Palmer Luckey, and Y Combinator President and CEO Garry Tan, have called for his return.

Over the past week, I’ve been overwhelmed by the love and support of friends, industry colleagues, and people I've never met. Thank you to everyone who has shown kindness to my family and me. It means the world to me.I came to the United States 53 years ago, and becoming an…
More reports continue to roll out that illustrate the shock and severity of Huang’s resignation from Nvidia.
Bloomberg reported that Huang looked “broken and shattered, his legendary energy depleted” by the time he surrendered his role on Wednesday night, uttering phrases like “whatever” and “I don’t care.”

Separately, The Wall Street Journal reported that Huang had been critical of his CFO and current interim CEO, Colette Kress. Huang is said to have described Kress as “a deer in the headlights” during a presentation this summer, and he had described Kress as someone who could not help him steer strategy or decision-making.

In a scathing letter sent to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Representative Richard Neal (D-MA) and Senator Ron Wyden (D-OR) said they will investigate how the Trump administration handled Nvidia’s chip sales to China, especially after Trump was briefed about Huang’s relationship with a purported Chinese spy.

“Although [Lutnick] and President Trump were reportedly briefed on this intelligence, the Administration did not appear to acknowledge this evident national security threat. On the contrary: despite reportedly learning of Mr. Huang’s compromising relationship last fall, President Trump granted Nvidia permission to sell its advanced H200 AI chips to China in December 2025 in exchange for a cut of the export sales,” the letter states.
That same evening, Senator Tim Scott (R-SC) requested that Huang and Lutnick both testify before the Senate Banking Committee.
“The American people deserve answers,” Scott wrote on X.

After Huang was already ousted from Nvidia, we continued to learn more incriminating claims about the former CEO. According to Reuters, Huang had a third affair with an additional, unnamed employee of Nvidia.

Nvidia said its board had accepted Huang’s resignation on Wednesday. The company’s current CFO, Colette Kress, will take over as interim CEO while still fulfilling her CFO duties. Nvidia is expected to conduct a larger search to determine a permanent successor to Huang.

Harvey C. Jones, a managing partner of Square Wave Ventures and former CEO of Synopsys, was appointed as the company’s first-ever chair of the board of directors. Jones has been on Nvidia’s board since 1993.
Later in the day, Huang confirmed that he would testify in Congress at some point before Thanksgiving, which falls on November 26.

“Jensen and I have been very at odds as some of you already know on export controls, but Nvidia is a very important company to the United States of America,” House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said to reporters. “I don’t want to see anything hurt in Nvidia, but he has some very serious questions to answer.”
The testimony is expected to take place behind closed doors, but Mast believes the briefing will be recorded and transcribed.

After reports of a second extramarital affair, Nvidia’s board reportedly plans to meet to discuss Huang’s future at the company, per The Wall Street Journal. Stock fell about 8% in after-hours trading on Wednesday and is down 11% in the past five days.
Huang famously delegates very little and has about 60 direct reports, he has said. The company has not had an obvious successor or a succession plan.
The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang also had an affair with Nvidia vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell, who reports directly to the CEO.
According to the report, Huang and Powell were captured on film “being affectionate” at a hotel during a conference earlier this year.

Huang has not responded to a request from three Republican congressmen to appear for a closed-door briefing for questioning about his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. House China Committee Chairman John Moolenaar said Wednesday on Fox Business that if Huang doesn’t agree to the briefing, he’ll likely be subpoenaed.
The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum.

Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. Founded in 2023, it became an Nvidia-preferred cloud partner, giving it priority access to chips, The Information reported. The Information also reported that Shanghai Century Litong facilitated buying $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia’s chips, including banned chips.

Nvidia’s head lawyer, Tim Teter, intervened in a 2025 U.S. government probe surrounding the suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International, Bloomberg reported. Teter contacted Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler asking questions about whether the Trump administration played a role in detaining Alice Huang.
In early 2025, Alice Huang and a business partner sought China-based investors for an Asian data center, promising they had no problem in securing GPUs, the Financial Times reported.
On Sunday night, President Trump weighed in on Huang’s controversy and showed support for the Nvidia CEO.
“I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he’s a fine person, but you never know what’s going on,” Trump said.
When asked if Huang should remain chief of Nvidia, Trump said, “I think so. Oh yeah, sure.”
Jensen Huang wrote in a letter to Nvidia employees — which was also published as a press release — that he cheated on his wife.
“I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Huang told his company. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”
Huang did not mention Alice Huang by name in the message, but linked his infidelity to “the national security concerns raised in news reports.”

“Nvidia’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American,” Huang wrote.
Nvidia shares slid over 5% the following day.

Three Republican congressmen — Chairman John Moolenaar of the House Select Committee on China, Chairman Brian Mast of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, and Chairman Rick Crawford of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence — sent a request to Huang for a closed-door joint briefing with their three committees.

“Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the [People’s Republic of China]’s access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” the chairmen wrote. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge U.S. technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk.”
U.S. officials had been investigating Alice Huang and Megaspeed for more than a year when the New York Times broke the story in late October that the two executives also had a close relationship.
An Nvidia spokesperson denied that this relationship was something out of the ordinary.

“Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo said. He added that “if the U.S. government believes that any person is a threat to American industry, it would let us know.”

U.S. officials circulated a secret memo among policymakers that warned that Megaspeed’s Alice Huang, who had a relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. This memo was not public knowledge until it was later reported by the New York Times.
Secretary of State Marco Rubio supervised the drafting of the memo.

Around the same time, per the New York Times’ report, U.S. President Donald Trump was briefed about intelligence findings that possible Chinese spy Alice Huang had formed a close relationship with Jensen Huang. Trump did not act on this information.
The Nvidia CEO, an ally of Trump, has repeatedly advocated for the U.S. government to let Nvidia expand its business in China.

Megaspeed was confirmed to be under investigation by both the U.S. and Singaporean governments in October 2025. As a customer of Nvidia, Megaspeed was suspected of helping Chinese companies get around American embargoes on chip exports.

Megaspeed, a neocloud that used Nvidia chips, had been renting computing power to Chinese internet giant Alibaba and other Chinese companies, the Times reported. A Commerce Department official who had visited Megaspeed’s data center in Malaysia in 2024 had found a hoard of Nvidia equipment that was still packed in boxes and the concern was that this equipment was being directly shipped somewhere else, like China, rather than installed and sold as a cloud service.
Jensen Huang had been spotted socializing with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang as early as 2024 in Taiwan, where the Nvidia CEO was born.

These investigations into Megaspeed highlighted concerns about the degree to which Nvidia is able to track its chip exports. At the time, an Nvidia spokesperson told press that the company did not have “any reason to believe products had been diverted.”

“NVIDIA visited multiple Megaspeed sites yet again earlier this week and confirmed what we previously observed — Megaspeed is running a small commercial cloud, like many other companies throughout the world, as allowed by U.S. export control rules,” the Nvidia spokesperson said at the time.

Nvidia 联合创始人、现任前首席执行官黄仁勋从未像 OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 或 SpaceXAI 的 Elon Musk 等人工智能领导者那样容易引起争议。但这位 63 岁的行业大佬最近承认，他在婚外情中背叛了结婚 40 年的妻子，这可能会产生超出黄的个人生活和美国国家安全范围的影响。
美国官员认为，黄可能的恋人之一、Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是一名中国间谍，一直向北京反馈信息。 （Alice Huang 是中国公民，与黄仁勋没有任何关系。）
Megaspeed 是一家总部位于新加坡的人工智能基础设施公司，据报道在过去两年购买了价值 48 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片。美国和新加坡此前都曾对 Megaspeed 进行过调查，怀疑该公司与中国非法共享芯片。据《纽约时报》报道，司法部此后接管了对该公司的联邦调查。
故事在周三突然发生转变。 《泰晤士报》援引 Nvidia 的五名员工的话说，黄还与该公司医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 存在婚外关系，后者直接向他汇报。英伟达、黄仁勋和鲍威尔尚未证实该报道。据报道，《纽约时报》记者联系到黄说，“我认为你不应该直接跟我说话”，然后就挂断了电话。
到周四凌晨，黄仁勋不再担任这家他 33 年前共同创立的公司的首席执行官。然后，周四下午，路透社又投下了一颗重磅炸弹，发表了一篇报道，指控黄与另一名未透露姓名的英伟达员工再次发生婚外情。
美国和中国正卷入一场激烈的技术军备竞赛，以建设最先进的人工智能基础设施，这可能会影响两国的经济未来、军事实力和创新能力。英伟达作为全球最大的人工智能芯片制造商之一，在这场竞争中很有价值，而人工智能芯片对于加速人工智能的发展至关重要。但作为一家美国公司，英伟达在向中国实体出售其最强大的芯片方面面临政府限制。
随着争议的展开，我们将最相关的事件按时间顺序排列，以便让您了解最新情况。
英伟达周二公布季度财报，营收 1158 亿美元，同比增长 103%，超出华尔街预期。尽管没有黄仁勋参与，公司面临着未知数，但临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯表示，全年收入也有望超出预期。该公司还计划上调 2028 财年的前景，表明有信心这一意外的领导层变动不会妨碍其发展轨迹。
“我们拥有世界上最好的技术专家，拥有世界一流的多年路线图，”克雷斯说。 “从商业角度来看，一切照旧。我们与客户、供应商、合作伙伴进行了交流。他们都 100% 支持我们。”
英伟达董事长哈维·C·琼斯（Harvey C. Jones）确认，该公司不会考虑恢复黄仁勋的职位。克雷斯还表示，英伟达将不再在中国销售其 H200 芯片，从而结束该公司参与美国禁止向中国销售先进芯片的一项有争议的漏洞。
黄仁勋发布了自一周多前承认婚外情以来的首次公开声明。
“自我离职以来，我收到了来自 NVIDIA 员工、投资者、业务合作伙伴和客户的大量电话，要求我重新担任首席执行官。当公司面临复杂的技术、市场、竞争和地缘政治动态时，许多人继续直接与我联系。NVIDIA 是一家千载难逢的公司。如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们的股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸接听这些电话并以首席执行官的身份回归。首席执行官，”他写道。
黄在科技行业的许多同事，包括埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)、Anduril创始人帕尔默·拉基(Palmer Luckey)和Y Combinator总裁兼首席执行官加里·谭(Garry Tan)都呼吁他回归。
在过去的一周里，我被朋友、行业同事和素未谋面的人的爱和支持所感动。感谢所有对我和我的家人表示善意的人。这对我来说意味着整个世界。53 年前我来到美国，并成为一名……
更多的报道不断涌现，说明黄仁勋从英伟达辞职的震惊和严重性。
据彭博社报道，当黄在周三晚上放弃自己的角色时，他看起来“心碎了，他的传奇能量已经耗尽”，说出了“随便”和“我不在乎”之类的短语。
另外，《华尔街日报》报道称，黄一直批评其首席财务官兼现任临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)。据说黄在今年夏天的一次演讲中将克雷斯描述为“车灯下的鹿”，他将克雷斯描述为无法帮助他指导战略或决策的人。
在发给商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克的一封措辞严厉的信中，马萨诸塞州民主党众议员理查德·尼尔 (Richard Neal) 和俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登 (Ron Wyden) 表示，他们将调查特朗普政府如何处理英伟达对华芯片销售，特别是在特朗普获悉黄仁勋与一名所谓的中国间谍的关系之后。
“据报道，[卢特尼克]和特朗普总统已获悉这一情报，但政府似乎并未承认这一明显的国家安全威胁。相反：尽管据报道去年秋天获悉黄先生的妥协关系，特朗普总统还是允许英伟达于 2025 年 12 月向中国出售其先进的 H200 人工智能芯片，以换取出口销售额的削减，”信中写道。
同一天晚上，参议员蒂姆·斯科特（R-SC）要求黄和卢特尼克在参议院银行委员会作证。
“美国人民应该得到答案，”斯科特在 X 上写道。
在黄仁勋被英伟达驱逐后，我们继续了解到更多关于这位前首席执行官的有罪指控。据路透社报道，黄仁勋与英伟达另一名未透露姓名的员工发生了第三次婚外情。
英伟达表示，其董事会已于周三接受黄仁勋的辞职。该公司现任首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)将接任临时首席执行官，同时仍履行首席财务官职责。预计英伟达将进行更大规模的搜寻，以确定黄仁勋的永久继任者。
Square Wave Ventures 管理合伙人、Synopsys 前首席执行官 Harvey C. Jones 被任命为该公司首任董事会主席。琼斯自 1993 年起一直担任 Nvidia 董事会成员。
当天晚些时候，黄证实他将在 11 月 26 日感恩节前的某个时间在国会作证。
众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特 (Brian Mast) 对记者表示：“詹森和我一直存在很大分歧，因为你们中的一些人已经了解出口管制，但英伟达对美利坚合众国来说是一家非常重要的公司。” “我不想看到英伟达受到任何伤害，但他有一些非常严肃的问题需要回答。”
预计证词将闭门进行，但马斯特相信简报将被记录和转录。
据《华尔街日报》报道，在第二次婚外情报道后，英伟达董事会计划召开会议，讨论黄在公司的未来。该股周三盘后交易中下跌约 8%，过去 5 天下跌 11%。
黄说，他以极少授权而闻名，他有大约 60 名直接下属。该公司尚未有明显的继任者或继任计划。
《纽约时报》报道称，黄仁勋还与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔(Kimberly Powell)有染，鲍威尔直接向首席执行官汇报。
据报道，今年早些时候的一次会议期间，黄和鲍威尔在一家酒店“亲热”的镜头被拍到。
黄没有回应三名共和党国会议员的要求，即出席闭门简报会，接受有关他与一名涉嫌中国间谍的恋情的质询。众议院中国委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔 (John Moolenaar) 周三在福克斯商业频道 (Fox Business) 上表示，如果黄不同意通报情况，他可能会被传唤。
这位 Nvidia 首席执行官退出了即将举行的 ElevenLabs 峰会和 Anthropic CEO 论坛上的演讲活动。
据报道，爱丽丝黄和她的家人在中国和新加坡建立了一个公司网络来收购英伟达芯片，包括成立了一家名为上海世纪利通的中国公司。据 The Information 报道，该公司成立于 2023 年，成为 Nvidia 首选的云合作伙伴，使其能够优先获得芯片。 《The Information》还报道称，上海世纪利通协助购买了价值 75 亿美元的英伟达芯片，其中包括违禁芯片。
据彭博社报道，英伟达首席律师 Tim Teter 介入了 2025 年美国政府针对 Megaspeed International 涉嫌走私人工智能芯片的调查。泰特联系了商务部副部长杰弗里·凯斯勒，询问特朗普政府是否在拘留爱丽丝·黄的过程中发挥了作用。
据英国《金融时报》报道，2025 年初，Alice Huang 和一位商业伙伴为亚洲数据中心寻找中国投资者，并承诺他们在确保 GPU 安全方面没有问题。
周日晚上，特朗普总统对黄仁勋的争议发表了看法，并对这位英伟达首席执行官表示支持。
“我没有和他谈过这件事。我只知道他是一个好人，但你永远不知道发生了什么，”特朗普说。
当被问及黄仁勋是否应该继续担任英伟达首席执行官时，特朗普说：“我想是的。哦，是的，当然。”
黄仁勋在给 Nvidia 员工的一封信中写道（该信也以新闻稿的形式发布），他对妻子不忠。
“我欠我的家人和你们所有人一个道歉，”黄告诉他的公司。 “我对我的妻子不忠。我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
黄在消息中没有提到黄爱丽的名字，但将他的不忠行为与“新闻报道中提出的国家安全担忧”联系起来。
黄写道：“英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持调查并将全力配合。我爱我们的国家和我们的公司。我致力于保护英伟达并支持美国的国家安全。我为自己是一名美国人而感到自豪和感激。”
第二天，Nvidia 股价下跌超过 5%。
三名共和党国会议员——众议院中国问题特别委员会主席约翰·莫勒纳尔、众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·马斯特和众议院情报常设特别委员会主席里克·克劳福德——向黄提出与他们的三个委员会举行闭门联合简报的请求。
主席们写道：“最近的报告对[中华人民共和国]获取美国敏感技术和信息提出了重大的国家安全担忧。” “中国渗透和获取美国尖端技术的问题是本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。国会确定美国国家安全面临风险的程度至关重要。”
美国官员对 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 进行了一年多的调查，《纽约时报》于 10 月底爆料称，这两位高管也关系密切。
英伟达发言人否认这种关系不寻常。
“Jensen 与黄女士的互动并不罕见或意外。与客户会面是首席执行官工作的一部分；Jensen 每年与数千名客户高管进行交谈，”Nvidia 发言人 John Rizzo 表示。他补充说，“如果美国政府认为任何人对美国工业构成威胁，就会让我们知道。”
美国官员在政策制定者中分发了一份秘密备忘录，警告称与黄仁勋有关系的 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang 是中国国家安全部的间谍。这份备忘录直到后来被《纽约时报》报道后才为公众所知。
国务卿马可·卢比奥监督了该备忘录的起草。
据《纽约时报》报道，大约在同一时间，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普获悉情报发现，可能的中国间谍爱丽丝·黄与黄仁勋建立了密切的关系。特朗普没有根据这一信息采取行动。
这位英伟达首席执行官是特朗普的盟友，多次主张美国政府让英伟达扩大在中国的业务。
Megaspeed于2025年10月被证实受到美国和新加坡政府的调查。作为英伟达的客户，Megaspeed涉嫌帮助中国企业规避美国芯片出口禁运。
据《泰晤士报》报道，使用英伟达芯片的 Neocloud Megaspeed 一直在向中国互联网巨头阿里巴巴和其他中国公司出租计算能力。一位商务部官员于 2024 年访问了位于马来西亚的 Megaspeed 数据中心，发现了一堆仍然装在盒子里的 Nvidia 设备，令人担忧的是这些设备被直接运往其他地方，比如中国，而不是作为云服务安装和销售。
早在 2024 年，黄仁勋就被发现在台湾（这位 Nvidia 首席执行官的出生地）与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 交往。
对 Megaspeed 的这些调查凸显了人们对 Nvidia 能够在多大程度上追踪其芯片出口的担忧。当时，英伟达发言人告诉媒体，该公司“没有任何理由相信产品已被转移”。
Nvidia 发言人当时表示：“本周早些时候，NVIDIA 再次访问了多个 Megaspeed 站点，并证实了我们之前观察到的情况——与世界各地的许多其他公司一样，Megaspeed 正在运行一个小型商业云，这是美国出口管制规则允许的。”
